about_the_game:
This will be a flesh and blood visual novel game, the protagonist needs to use their abilities as much as possible to fight against the black and evil forces in the city, and discovering the truth about the monsters in the abyss. Along with a large number of battle scenes, the game will also include Galgame's classic love plot. As the plot progresses, how will your relationship with the female protagonist change and what kind of ending will you have

In a corner of the city, a bridge hole emits a foul odor. The garbage in the riverbed emitted a bloody luster under the sunset. The aura emitted seemed to come from the depths of hell's terrifying whispers, echoing directly in the depths of my chaotic consciousness, forming an indescribable driving force that led me inside

Gameplay and Goals

This is a visual novel game, belonging to a type of video game. Compared to regular games, the gameplay is weaker and more focused on the plot. Combining presentation format with slides and novels. During gameplay, most of the time you only need to press the Enter or Space key on the keyboard or click the adv. button with the mouse to advance the game progress

Character introduction

Xing Yi：A mysterious girl with exquisite appearance but terrifying power

Feng Mo：The protagonist, was originally a otaku loved playing galgames. After being possessed by a monster, he gained uncontrollable power and became a murderer in the process of losing control

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains some violent and bloody elements, terrifying plotlines

short_description: The protagonist of this story is a ogre, living a nightmare like life alone. Until one day, when he was about to be killed, a mysterious girl appeared and saved him. With her help, gained even stronger power. But he didn't know that this power could plunge him into the abyss of destruction
